name: Save answer
description: Saves the interviewee's confirmed answer to the current question and returns the next state. Rejects the write with a conflict if the expected question order, or the expected topic order when supplied, no longer matches the backend.

inputFields.label: Expected question order
inputFields.description: The order number of the question the answer is for, taken verbatim from the last state. Used for optimistic concurrency; a mismatch returns a conflict and no write.

inputFields.label: Expected topic order
inputFields.description: The order number of the topic the question belongs to, taken verbatim from the last state. Question order restarts at 1 in every topic, so this stops a stale answer from landing on a same-numbered question in a later topic; a mismatch returns a conflict and no write.

inputFields.label: Final answer
inputFields.description: The interviewee's confirmed, final answer to the current question. It should capture the essence of the answer, and reassure the user a more extensive summary will be generated later. Do not over-summarize. Save only after explicit confirmation.

inputFields.label: Raw user messages
inputFields.description: Required. The interviewee's own messages for this question, in chronological order: the initial answer plus every follow-up, copied verbatim. Do not EVER paraphrase, condense, omit, or substitute the cleaned finalAnswer. This is of utmost importance. Only exception: rewrite criticism of other people (including accounts of their mistakes and their quoted words) and private details as a neutral process lesson not tied to the person.
